body.contents: A factions SMP: team up with up to three friends, claim land, and raid or defend it. You agreed to the short rules on the way in; the full rulebook is in the Discord.
Factions need members, and most start small. The recruiting posts in #smp-forum say who's looking.

contents.text: Links to the Discord, the map, the rules and the store are in the pause menu, under
